name: Painted Hills Golf Club
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Blue, White. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

17: OSM has no golf=hole way for 17 (17 of 18), so the geometry fallback built it with par '17', hcp 3 and no card yards; the page treats it as a tee-shot hole (Mid iron landing 192 yds out on a 139-yd hole).
